Write a Python function semver_compare(a, b) that compares two Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version strings and returns -1 if a has lower precedence than b, 0 if equal precedence and 1 if higher. A version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, each a non-negative integer written without leading zeros ("0" is fine, "01" is not), optionally followed by "-" and a pre-release, then optionally by "+" and build metadata. The pre-release and the build metadata are each one or more dot-separated identifiers; an identifier is non-empty and made only of ASCII letters, ASCII digits and "-"; a pre-release identifier made only of digits must not have a leading zero. Precedence: compare MAJOR, MINOR and PATCH numerically; a version with a pre-release is lower than the same version without one; two pre-releases compare identifier by identifier from the left: two all-digit identifiers numerically, two others in ASCII order, and an all-digit identifier is lower than any other; if every shared identifier is equal, the one with more identifiers is higher. Build metadata is ignored. An invalid version string must raise ValueError. import re

def semver_compare(a, b):
    # Validate version strings
    pattern = r'^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:-([0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*))?(?:\+([0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*))?$'
    
    ma = re.match(pattern, a)
    mb = re.match(pattern, b)
    
    if not ma or not mb:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid version string: {a!r} or {b!r}")
    
    # Parse core version
    a_major, a_minor, a_patch = int(ma.group(1)), int(ma.group(2)), int(ma.group(3))
    b_major, b_minor, b_patch = int(mb.group(1)), int(mb.group(2)), int(mb.group(3))
    
    # Parse pre-release
    a_pre = ma.group(4)
    b_pre = mb.group(4)
    
    # Compare MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH
    if (a_major, a_minor, a_patch) != (b_major, b_minor, b_patch):
        return -1 if (a_major, a_minor, a_patch) < (b_major, b_minor, b_patch) else 1
    
    # Same core version - handle pre-release
    # A version with no pre-release is higher than one with pre-release
    if a_pre is None and b_pre is None:
        return 0
    if a_pre is None:
        return 1  # a has no pre-release, b has one -> a is higher
    if b_pre is None:
        return -1  # b has no pre-release, a has one -> a is lower
    
    # Both have pre-release - compare identifier by identifier
    a_ids = a_pre.split('.')
    b_ids = b_pre.split('.')
    
    # Compare each identifier
    for ai, bi in zip(a_ids, b_ids):
        # Determine if identifiers are all-digits
        ai_is_digit = ai.isdigit()
        bi_is_digit = bi.isdigit()
        
        if ai_is_digit and bi_is_digit:
            # Both numeric - compare numerically
            ai_num = int(ai)
            bi_num = int(bi)
            if ai_num < bi_num:
                return -1
            elif ai_num > bi_num:
                return 1
        elif ai_is_digit:
            # a is numeric, b is not -> a is lower
            return -1
        elif bi_is_digit:
            # b is numeric, a is not -> a is higher
            return 1
        else:
            # Both non-numeric - compare ASCII order
            if ai < bi:
                return -1
            elif ai > bi:
                return 1
    
    # All shared identifiers are equal
    # The one with more identifiers is higher
    if len(a_ids) < len(b_ids):
        return -1
    elif len(a_ids) > len(b_ids):
        return 1
    else:
        return 0
